Returns the official name(s), legal form, status, legal situation, start date, registered office address,

tools.name: be_company_search
tools.description:
Search active Belgian legal entities by name in KBO Open Data (legal, abbreviated and commercial names).

Optional: a 4-digit Belgian postcode of the registered office to narrow the result.
Returns at most 10 matches with enterprise number, matched name, legal form, postcode and municipality.

tools.name: be_enterprise_number_validate
tools.description:
Validate the format and the mod-97 check digits of a Belgian enterprise number (KBO/BCE) or Belgian VAT
number (BE + 10 digits), offline without any database. Returns the normalized forms (0769.605.324 and
BE0769605324) and whether it is an enterprise number or an establishment unit number.
